```java
public DeliveryResponse dispatchDelivery(String requestId, String deliveryKey, String allocationKey,
        String volume, String dispatchUtc, Integer travelMinutes, Long expectedVersion, String actor) {
    requireKey("requestId", requestId);
    requireKey("deliveryKey", deliveryKey);
    requireKey("allocationKey", allocationKey);
    requireKey("X-Actor-Id", actor);
    BigDecimal qty = parseAmount("volume", volume);
    long dispatchNanos = parseInstant("dispatchUtc", dispatchUtc);
    if (travelMinutes == null || travelMinutes < 1 || travelMinutes > 120) 400;
    if (expectedVersion == null) 400;
    long arrivalNanos = dispatchNanos + travelMinutes * 60e9;
    String params = structuredParams("DELIVERY_DISPATCH", actor, allocationKey, deliveryKey, qty.toPlainString(), dispatchNanos, travelMinutes, expectedVersion);
    return runCommand("DELIVERY_DISPATCH", requestId, params, DeliveryResponse.class, () -> {
        AllocationRow allocation = repository.findAllocationByKey(allocationKey);
        if (allocation == null) 404;
        lockWindowOf(allocation);
        allocation = repository.lockAllocationByKey(allocationKey);
        if (!allocation.requester().equals(actor)) 409 NOT_OWNER;
        if (!APPROVED.equals(allocation.status())) 409 ALLOCATION_NOT_APPROVED;
        if (allocation.version() != expectedVersion) 409 VERSION_CONFLICT;
        BigDecimal dispatched = repository.sumDispatchedByAllocation(allocationKey);
        if (dispatched.add(qty).compareTo(allocation.heldAmount()) > 0) 422;
        long now = nowNanos();
        repository.insertDelivery(deliveryKey, allocationKey, allocation.windowId(), qty, dispatchNanos, travelMinutes, arrivalNanos, actor, now);
        repository.touchAllocationForDispatch(allocation.id(), now);
        return toDeliveryResponse(repository.findDeliveryByKey(deliveryKey));
    });
}
```

```java
        return toDeliveryResponse(repository.findDeliveryByKey(deliveryKey));

}
```
